name: HFT_System
description: This is an educational high-frequency trading system simulator built in C++17 with a real-time GUI. It demonstrates HFT concepts through a complete momentum trading strategy using RSI, MACD, and moving averages, with lock-free data structures, work-stealing thread pools, and performance monitoring.

paragraphs: A C++17 trading-engine sandbox: a limit-order-book matching engine, two technical trading strategies, a backtester, and a desktop app for running strategies live against a simulated market.
Educational project. All market data is synthetic (random walks). Results show how strategies behave mechanically, not how they would perform on real markets, and nothing here is trading advice.
features: Desktop app (Qt 6): live simulation with a price chart and trade markers, a backtester with an equity curve, and editable strategy and risk settings. No coding needed.
Two strategies: Momentum (SMA / RSI / MACD) and Mean Reversion (price vs SMA), both with stop loss and take profit.
Backtester: runs a strategy over a price series and reports return, trades, win rate, max drawdown and an annualised Sharpe ratio.
Matching engine: price-time priority limit and market orders, partial fills, cancels, mutex-protected.
Risk manager: per-order quantity and notional caps, a per-batch order limit and a daily volume cap.
